notes:
**Hutsix v3.0.0**(released)

### Settings & Profiles
- Removed the non-functional "Enable Pause/Abort hotkeys (Pause / Scroll Lock)" checkbox from the Profile Manager. Global hotkeys are now controlled only from Settings → Global Hotkeys; the per-profile flag this checkbox wrote was never read by the runtime.
- The "Start Auto-Activate Monitor On App Launch" master switch now shows its true state: it appears checked while the legacy default (auto-start until you choose otherwise) is in effect, instead of appearing off while the monitor was actually running at boot.
- The confirmation message when enabling Auto Activate now correctly reflects whether the master switch will apply it at boot.

### Global Hotkeys
- Fixed per-profile switching: the Switch Next / Switch Prev hotkeys now keep their configuration and callbacks after a profile is deactivated and re-activated, and edits made in the Global Hotkeys dialog take effect immediately instead of only after restarting the app.
- Fixed the headless (non-GUI) fallback for Switch Next / Switch Prev to match the documented defaults (Ctrl+Alt+Page Down / Ctrl+Alt+Page Up).

### Profile Manager
- Replaced the hidden tabs with clearly labeled, visible steps ("1. Create Profile" / "2. Add Bindings") and added step hints so the two-stage workflow is obvious.
- After creating a profile, the window now switches straight to the bindings step with the new profile already selected.
- Profile names are now validated with a clear message before saving (rejects "." / ".." and path separators).
- Deleting a trigger or action that is still used by a binding now warns and lists the affected bindings first.
- The program dropdown now reliably restores your selection after a background refresh.
- The window keeps your in-progress selection when re-opened (clears only on first show), and pressing Enter in the name field creates the profile.
- Renamed the window to "Profile Manager" and relabeled the pause option to "Also Pause While Active".
- Debounced binding-overview refreshes and consolidated profile-list/column-sizing logic so the window stays responsive with many profiles.

### Repeat
- Added a new "After cooldown" repeat mode for hotkey bindings: the action re-fires as soon as its cooldown elapses while the trigger is held (previously repeat used a fixed interval, with cooldown acting only as a throttle).

### Matching speed & accuracy
- Trigger checks are noticeably faster: the parts of your templates that never change are now computed once and reused, only the template that actually matched gets a second look, and a near-perfect match skips the extra double-check entirely.
- You can now fine-tune how strictly Hutsix double-checks image matches (per trigger) when you need more precision or more speed.

### Reliability
- Fixed a rare case where two bindings with the same name could interfere with each other's repeat actions — each one now runs independently.
- Global hotkeys are now handled by a single internal controller, so their settings and shortcuts always stay in sync across every part of the app.
- Profile names are now checked in one place with a consistent message everywhere (create window, runtime, and imports), and imported profiles with unsafe names are rejected before anything is written to disk.

### Consistency & cleanup
- The default on/off state for global hotkeys is now the same in every launch mode (the main window and the headless profile runner previously disagreed).
- Removed leftover unused code and merged duplicate helper routines.

### Tests
- Added automated coverage for the real HDR screen-capture path (it runs on HDR displays and skips cleanly on others), plus more regression tests for profiles, repeat, hotkeys, and timing.

### Housekeeping
- Corrected the v2.3.0 release note: only Auto Activate and Auto Pause On Focus Loss are per-profile; Global Hotkeys remain a single app-wide setting.
